# Davy Keith

- **Age:** Nine years old (at the end of Volume 5)  <sub>[v2 c1 P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033), [v3 c1 P31](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0031), [v3 c18 P5](../source/v03-c18.md#nw-v03-c18-p0005)</sub>

- **Nicknames:** Davy-boy  <sub>[v2 c16 P3](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0003), [v2 c20 P9](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0009), [v2 c27 P9](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0009)</sub>; Mr. Davy Keith  <sub>[v2 c8 P11](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0011)</sub>

## Appearance

Davy is a fair-complexioned, handsome boy who is wide-built and grows rapidly as he gets older. He has a crop of fuzzy, yellow ringlets all over his round head and a snub nose, paired with dancing, roguish, hazel eyes. His mouth is filled with smiles, and he features a single dimple in one cheek, giving him a lopsided look when he laughs.

_Sources: [v2 c8 P11](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0011), [v2 c8 P25](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0025), [v2 c20 P9](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0009), [v2 c22 P19](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0019), [v3 c17 P8](../source/v03-c17.md#nw-v03-c17-p0008)_

## Personality

Davy is a mischievous, lively, and inquisitive boy who is constantly full of curiosity and always "wanting to know" about everything. He is irrepressible, highly active, and loves excitement, often getting into trouble out of sheer love of fun. Though he can be naughty, wilful, and prone to endless questions, he possesses a warm, affectionate heart, an impetuous nature, and a knack for winning love from others. He admires strength and manliness, but he also responds deeply to affection and guidance.

_Sources: [v2 c7 P30](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0030), [v2 c8 P8](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0008), [v2 c8 P25](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0025), [v2 c10 P53](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0053), [v2 c10 P84](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0084), [v2 c10 P89](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0089), [v2 c20 P8](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0008)_

## History

Davy Keith and his twin sister Dora were orphaned when their mother, Mary Keith, died after a long illness. Having no other immediate family available to care for them, they were taken in by Marilla Cuthbert and Anne Shirley at Green Gables. Davy quickly established himself as a handful, engaging in constant pranks such as dropping a caterpillar down a girl's neck in church, trapping his sister in a toolhouse, putting a toad in Marilla's bed, and stealing plum jam. Under Anne's sympathetic and patient guidance, Davy gradually learned to distinguish right from wrong, promising never to tell falsehoods and working to improve his behavior. When his uncle Richard Keith passed away, leaving a trust fund for the twins, Marilla and Anne became his permanent guardians. Davy entered Avonlea School, formed a close friendship with Milty Boulter, and developed a keen interest in farming. Though he still engaged in occasional mischief, he grew into a reliable, hard-working boy who took pride in helping around Green Gables.
